first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ, the most acute symptom. Memory_91 shows activation messaging drove week-one engagement and meaningful first actions. Memory_86 demonstrated onboarding shortening improved completion and adoption. Verifying both validates the mechanism and durability of messaging lift. While promotional_pricing addresses the competitive threat directly, it risks margin erosion on core SMB cohorts and may not address the underlying engagement decay. Activation_messaging targets the root metric decline with proven upside (memory_91) and complements onboarding work (memory_86, memory_31). Enterprise_sales_assist addresses a different segment. Referral_incentive works best in established customers, not in a down-activation environment. A standard_experiment scope fits the single-week constraint and allows measurement of week-one and early retention cohorts before broader rollout.
